4.DSCR:
A space transport ship operated by the $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$.
As with the old $$シャトル$$, every employee except $$ワッ太$$ boards it, dividing up duties from piloting to weapons control.
The old $$シャトル$$ was moderately damaged in battle with Jackal, an executive of the $$ロボット帝国$$, but was rebuilt with funding from the Director-General of the Space Defense Agency, gaining upgrades across the board in firepower, cruising speed, and more.
Its role remains unchanged: it combines with Trider's cruising form, Cosmic, to become the Fortress, and its main uses are transporting supplies and personnel. But thanks to reinforcements better suited for combat, it has become an even more reliable support machine for Trider.
For the managing director, too, the results of the refit -- improved work efficiency without denting the company's own pocket -- seem to have been thoroughly satisfying.
Though its exterior changed dramatically, the interior remains much as it was before. The dining salon is still in place, and the homely atmosphere of the workplace, with employees gathering around the table together, has not changed either.

proofread.reason: mistranslation: 中破 means moderately damaged (between 小破 and 大破), not heavily damaged

7.DSCR:
A robot that appeared in Episode 2, 'The Stolen $$鉄人$$!'
The second robot built by the Robot Mafia led by $$ブランチ$$, constructed at their undersea hideout.
$$正太郎$$, who had fallen into $$ブランチ$$'s trap and had his V-Con stolen, and $$大塚$$, who had likewise been taken captive, instead seized this machine and escaped in it.
Piloted by $$大塚$$, it faced off against $$鉄人$$ No. 28, controlled by $$ブランチ$$, but stood no chance at all.

10.DSCR:
A robot that appeared in Episode 31, 'The Fortress Comet Attacks!'
The third $$スペースロボ$$ sent by the Space Demon King. It broke its body apart into separate parts and mixed them in among meteor fragments to descend to Earth. It repeatedly combined and separated its parts at will to dodge $$鉄人$$'s attacks.
In the end, $$鉄人$$ caught it in a moment of separation, breaking into its body with a Rolling Attack, and it exploded.

13.DSCR:
A small saucer used by the Space Demon King's forces.
It typically launches from a giant saucer and attacks its target in formations of several units.

14.DSCR:
A giant saucer used by the Space Demon King's forces.
It can carry numerous small saucers as well as Space Robos inside it.
It has been commanded not only by the Majin generals who serve the Space Demon King, but also, on occasion, by $$ブランチ$$, who was lent it by the Demon King and boarded it to lead an attack.

proofread.reason: mistranslation: 魔人将軍 is a class (the Majin generals under the Space Demon King), not one person 'General Majin'; and 'to direct an attack' was wrongly attached to the lending: Branch boarded it and took command of an attack (乗り込み、攻撃の指揮を執った); dropped the added 'himself'

18.DSCR:
A combat mecha that appeared in Episode 51, '$$ズール$$ Appears!'
It appeared before $$タケル$$ after he had been fitted with a Devil Ring.
It is notable for its two snake-like heads, but carries no particular armament, attacking instead by charging.
It showed a charging power that did not weaken even under a hit from Mars Flash, but was defeated by a counter Final $$ゴッドマーズ$$.

20.DSCR:
A combat mecha that appeared in Episode 54, 'Farewell! $$タケル$$ and $$ロゼ$$.'
Piloted by the $$ゲシュタルト$$ member $$ボーデ$$, it fires a scorching beam from its chest that generates magma. It lurked on the seabed near Greenland, intending to sink all the world's land beneath a boiling sea.
It drove $$ガイヤー$$ into a corner, caught between the undersea battle and the torment of the Devil Ring.
It was defeated by $$ゴッドマーズ$$, who combined with the support of Uranus -- capable of freezing even magma -- and in the end sank to the bottom of the sea.

21.DSCR:
A combat mecha that appeared in the final episode, 'A First Smile for the Galaxy.'
It appeared before the $$クラッシャー隊$$ as they headed out to investigate the waters off the Hawaiian Islands.
All six members of the $$ゲシュタルト$$ ride aboard it, and a large-caliber beam is fired from its underside.
It fended off the $$コスモクラッシャー$$ when it interposed itself between the mecha and $$ガイヤー$$, but was defeated before $$ゴッドマーズ$$. Immediately afterward, the $$ゲシュタルト$$ members who leapt out from inside it gathered together, and $$ズール$$ was fully revived.

23.DSCR:
An AT developed by the $$ギルガメス$$ forces.
It stands as the archetypal AT, highly versatile, with numerous modification parts and usable weapons available for it. It is also excellent in terms of production efficiency, and its total production numbers are very high.
It is equipped with everything that would become standard on later ATs, including the fixed arm punch weapon and the gliding wheels on its legs.
Its greatest feature, the triple turret lens on its head, combines standard zoom, wide angle, and precision aiming, and rotates to switch between them as the situation demands.
Note that this version is the one that was carried aboard the space battleship X, and shows a slight improvement in performance compared to the standard model.
AT is short for 'Armored Trooper,' and its pilots are often called 'AT riders.'
AT riders are also sometimes called 'VOTOMS riders.' VOTOMS means 'the lowest of bastards,' a slang term coined to mock the pilots put into weapons whose survivability was cut down in exchange for higher production efficiency. There is also a theory that VOTOMS is an acronym for 'Vertical One-man Tank for Offence and Maneuver.'
It is the machine $$キリコ$$ used most, but apparently not out of any particular attachment or fondness -- simply because he was used to it and it was easy to get hold of.
Incidentally, from its model number, 'ATM-09-ST,' ATs directly descended from the $$スコープドッグ$$ are sometimes called the '09 series.'

24.DSCR:
The state of a $$スコープドッグ$$ fitted with a Round Mover pack.
The Round Mover is a vernier-equipped mission pack for operating 09-series ATs in outer space. Its acceleration and operating time fall short of dedicated space fighters, making it unsuited to long-range incursions, but the thruster units extending in every direction grant high maneuverability and allow 360-degree movement in space, making it a highly versatile piece of equipment.
09-series ATs can also be fitted with the Parachute Pack, used for atmospheric drop operations. Between the two, they can carry out operations across a wide range of environments, from outer space down to the ground.

25.DSCR:
A $$スコープドッグ$$ customized by $$キリコ$$.
In order to counter Niiba's $$エクルビス$$, it has had its armor thoroughly stripped down to reduce weight. Its resistance to gunfire has dropped sharply, but combined with the major weight reduction and additional gliding wheels, it achieves high mobility and high maneuverability.
Its shoulders have been deliberately painted red to provoke Niiba, who bears a grudge against the Red Shoulders.

27.DSCR:
An AT assembled in Gomor, the capital of the planet $$クエント$$.
The 'DT' in its name stands for 'Desert-Trip.'
It carries unique, high-performance equipment, including a Quent-element metal detection sensor with extremely high enemy-detection ability, a pile bunker mounted on its left arm, and a dedicated assault rifle.
Like other Berserga units, it has been customized to suit the battlefield it is deployed to, and this particular unit has been fitted with a sand-tripper unit for desert warfare.
This machine is a restoration of an old unit that had been sitting in a storage center -- 'a wreck, but a quality one,' in the words of $$ゴウト$$, who handled the refit.
It is originally a machine used only by mercenaries from $$クエント$$, but with $$シャッコ$$ injured, $$フィアナ$$ boarded it instead and pursued $$キリコ$$, who had become Wiseman's successor.

proofread.reason: mistranslation: 索敵能力 is enemy-detection (searching) ability, not 'target-tracking'

28.DSCR:
A color variant of the $$スコープドッグ$$ used by the $$メルキア$$ Regional Army.
Thanks to its excellent versatility, the $$スコープドッグ$$ exists in far more than just different paint schemes -- there are also variant machines such as the 'Marshydog,' for use in water and wetland combat, and the '$$バーグラリードッグ$$,' for use in rough terrain.
$$メルキア$$, incidentally, is the planetary nation at the core of the $$ギルガメス$$ Stellar Federation, having risen to the status of leading planet thanks to its achievement of developing ATs in the closing days of the Third Galactic War (the $$百年戦争$$). The $$メルキア$$ Regional Army is its own dedicated planetary force.

30.DSCR:
An AT developed by the $$バララント$$ Army to counter the $$ギルガメス$$ forces.
'$$ファッティー$$' is a derogatory nickname used by the $$ギルガメス$$ side; its official $$バララント$$ designation is Frogger.
The stubby, barrel-like build that gave rise to the nickname is the result of an unsuccessful attempt to miniaturize its power plant and rocket propellant tanks, though it did produce good results in terms of heavy armor.
It is not equipped with a roller dash mechanism, but carries verniers at various points, including a large rocket nozzle on its back and units on its shoulders, waist, and soles, achieving high spatial maneuverability. Built around group combat as its basic tactic, it fought $$ギルガメス$$ ATs, which individually outperformed it, to a standstill.
Its main weapon is a recoilless catapult launcher, with options such as the Hard Bread Gun also available.

31.DSCR:
A $$ＰＳ$$-exclusive AT developed by the $$バララント$$ Army.
Its control systems are wired directly into the pilot's nervous system, giving it phenomenal maneuverability.
The base machine was the $$秘密結社$$'s $$ストライクドッグ$$, making it a unit that gathers together the AT development technologies of both the $$ギルガメス$$ and $$バララント$$ forces.
It has missiles and machine guns built in, but carries no handheld firearms, relying mainly on close combat with the pile bunker on its right arm and the crab claw on its left.
In the town of A-Kova, a prototype unit gathered real combat data by taking part in $$バトリング$$, going by the ring name 'Danger Melon.'

32.DSCR:
A ground battleship developed by the $$バララント$$ Army.
A type that emphasizes its function as a mothership over gun firepower, it functions largely as a mobile base.
In the early days of the $$百年戦争$$ it achieved results on the ground that could be called invincible, but it eventually faded from use due to its high construction costs and the changes in tactics brought about by the rise of ATs.
Niiba, burning with obsession to bring down $$キリコ$$, wired the control system directly into their own brain just as with the $$エクルビス$$, operating the massive vessel as an extension of their own body.

proofread.reason: pronoun: 'his' for Niiba, whose gender is settled neither by the Japanese (自らの脳 / 自分の肉体) nor by the glossary (no character entry); replaced with neutral 'their'

33.DSCR:
A custom AT exclusive to the 13th Rank of the Pan-Galactic Society $$マーティアル$$, the 'Shield of Order.'
A custom machine based on the $$エルドスピーネ$$, it uses high-performance parts throughout, giving it performance far beyond comparison to the original machine, and letting it keep up with the reaction speed of $$テイタニア$$, a $$ネクスタント$$.
It is equipped with an electromagnetic pile bunker integrated into its shield, and displays unmatched strength in close combat.

34.DSCR:
An AT used by the Pan-Galactic Society $$マーティアル$$.
Developed with the sole purpose of defending the holy land of $$アレギウム$$, it is designed with movement through the forests and stone architecture around the holy land in mind.
It carries unique equipment: the Seilspyde, which fires a harpoon called the Harpune, and the Spinlad, which reels it back in. With these, it is capable of hoisting itself up and down, and of handling movement along the vertical axis as well.

37.DSCR:
The machine completed when $$桂$$'s beloved Bronco II, badly damaged, was repaired and, in the process, reinforced and modified using $$エマーン$$ technology.
The legs of the Bronco II were kept as they were, but at $$桂$$'s request -- having taken a liking to the handling when he piloted the Molabar -- that machine's arm units were fitted on. Furthermore, in addition to the sympathetic system, three inertial control systems, two anti-gravity levitation units, and a nuclear reactor with output approaching 500,000 horsepower were installed, and despite being a hasty patchwork job, the result surpassed the performance of conventional Drifados. Thanks to this high performance, a mass-production model was later developed as well.
Another major feature is its Variable Geometry ability, allowing it to take four different forms to suit the situation: its humanoid form, the Orguroid, along with Flyer, Gerwalk, and Tank forms.
When it was completed, the members of the $$ファクトリー$$ discussed what to call the new Bronco II, with everyone throwing out their own suggestions, from 'Valhalla' to 'Gammon.' In the end, $$ファクトリー$$ member $$ジャビー$$ settled on '$$オーガス$$,' taken from the name of a war god from the world he originally came from.
Incidentally, 'Nebulado,' one of the names put forward, was the show's working title back in its planning stages.

proofread.reason: wrong referent + mistranslation: その腕部 are the arms of the Molabar (the machine Kei liked to pilot), not the Bronco II whose legs were kept, so 'its arm units' misleads; and フライヤー is 'Flyer', not 'Fighter'

38.DSCR:
A transformable mobile suit developed by $$アナハイム・エレクトロニクス$$ for the $$エゥーゴ$$.
A machine that represents the culmination of the know-how cultivated through the Zeta Project, it was completed by combining the $$ガンダムＭｋ－Ⅱ$$'s Movable Frame technology with the concept of Flying Armor.
The adoption of Gundarium gamma armor plating and a new-model generator gives it an excellent power-to-weight ratio, achieving unrivaled mobility. Its high output also makes it possible to use the Hyper Mega Launcher, a portable weapon whose power rivals even the Mega Bazooka Launcher.
It can also transform into the $$ウェイブ・ライダー$$, granting it tremendous cruising range and acceleration. It is a machine capable of performing in every scenario, from single-handed atmospheric entry and solo flight within the atmosphere to operations carrying an escort unit on its back.
Later, a Bio-Sensor -- a simplified $$サイコミュ$$ system -- was installed, giving it a tracking response matched to $$カミーユ$$'s finely honed reflexes. It has also been observed to display inexplicable phenomena not included in its specifications, such as interfering with and stopping the movements of enemy mobile suits.

39.DSCR:
$$Ｚガンダム$$'s cruising form.
It is used as an air and space combat fighter and can also carry an escort unit on its back, but its greatest feature is its ability to enter the atmosphere on its own.
It is called the $$ウェイブ・ライダー$$ because it gains lift from a compressed shock wave formed on the underside of the machine.

40.DSCR:
A mobile suit independently developed by the $$ティターンズ$$ at Grips.
It is a redesign of the original $$ガンダム$$, but its greatest feature is that it did away with the Core Block System in favor of the Movable Frame. This allowed for movement much closer to that of a human body, achieving high mobility. Other new technologies incorporated throughout the machine include a linear-seat cockpit with an all-around monitor and a detachable Vulcan Pod System.
After it was seized from the $$ティターンズ$$ by $$カミーユ$$ and the others and joined the $$エゥーゴ$$, its color scheme was changed from black to white.
Its main armaments are the Beam Rifle, Beam Saber, Long Rifle, Hyper Bazooka, and others.

41.DSCR:
The $$エゥーゴ$$'s first transformable mobile suit, developed by $$アナハイム・エレクトロニクス$$.
As a machine built to verify the transformation mechanism for the Zeta Project, its combat ability is low, and its airframe strength is not especially high either.
It was deployed aboard the $$アーガマ$$ and operated by Reccoa and $$ファ$$.
Two units appeared in the film, and were active in various scenes.

42.DSCR:
The $$エゥーゴ$$'s first transformable mobile suit, developed by $$アナハイム・エレクトロニクス$$.
Its performance in Mobile Suit form is mediocre, but in Mobile Armor form it excels in mobility and acceleration, and it has been seen using its speed to run circles around enemies.

43.DSCR:
A Newtype-exclusive mobile suit developed by $$アクシズ$$.
It was developed under the design philosophy of turning the old $$ジオン公国$$'s mobile armor, the Elmeth, into a mobile suit. It is equipped with funnels, a development of the remote-attack bits.
Its $$サイコミュ$$ is also used not only to control the funnels but to control the machine itself, achieving a high degree of responsiveness.
Its other armament is a beam gun that doubles as a beam saber.

44.DSCR:
A Newtype-exclusive mobile suit developed by $$アクシズ$$.
It was developed under the design philosophy of turning the old $$ジオン公国$$'s mobile armor, the Elmeth, into a mobile suit. It is equipped with funnels, a development of the remote-attack bits.
Its $$サイコミュ$$ is also used not only to control the funnels but to control the machine itself, achieving a high degree of responsiveness.
Its other armament is a beam gun that doubles as a beam saber.

45.DSCR:
A mass-production transformable mobile suit developed by $$アクシズ$$.
Originally based on the Gaza A and Gaza B, used for development and construction work, it was developed into a transformable mobile suit with combat capability. In Mobile Armor form, it attacks with Knuckle Buster bombardment and anti-ship attacks using its leg claws. Its mobility and close-combat ability are low, and its basic tactic is group bombardment from long range. On the other hand, its production efficiency is high, and it is mass-produced at $$アクシズ$$'s shipyards.
Because $$アクシズ$$ and the Earth Federation Forces once allied for a time, it carries designation numbers from both militaries: $$アクシズ$$'s AMX-003 and the Federation's MMT-1.
Aside from those above, its other main armaments are a beam gun and a beam saber.

47.DSCR:
A mass-production mobile suit that serves as the Earth Federation Forces' mainstay unit.
Developed by combining the design data of the GM and Nemo lines, both of which had undergone extensive development and improvement, it boasts high performance and reliability. It was preferentially deployed to the $$ロンド・ベル$$ task force and saw long service across many theaters afterward.
Notably, it was the first Federation mainstay unit to be developed and mass-produced not within the military itself but by Anaheim Electronics.
Its main armaments are a beam rifle, beam saber, vulcan guns, hand grenades, and so on.

48.DSCR:
A prototype mobile suit developed by $$アナハイム・エレクトロニクス$$.
It is a simplified mass-production prototype of the $$Ｚガンダム$$, and becomes a mobile armor when equipped with the Back Weapon System. This mechanism let it maintain high performance while improving ease of production, aiming for mass production. Even so, its production cost remained high compared to other mass-produced units, and in the end only a single unit saw actual deployment, with the $$ロンド・ベル$$ task force.
$$リ・ガズィ$$ is short for 'Refined $$ガンダム$$ Zeta.'
Its main armaments, besides the Back Weapon System, are a beam saber, beam rifle, twin grenade launcher, vulcan guns, and so on.

49.DSCR:
The mobile armor form taken when the $$リ・ガズィ$$ equips the Back Weapon System.
Its mobility, long-range cruising ability, firepower, and more are all dramatically improved. However, the Back Weapon System is used in a nearly disposable manner, and once detached to return to mobile suit form, it cannot be re-equipped on the battlefield.
Its main armaments are the mega beam cannon mounted on the nose, missile launchers, and so on.

51.DSCR:
A mass-production mobile suit of the $$ネオ・ジオン$$ forces.
A machine that could be called the culmination of Zeon-line mobile suits to date, it is characterized by the high versatility of its abundant equipment options and the high production efficiency of its simple structure, and it serves as $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s mainstay unit.
Its main armaments are a beam machine gun, beam sword axe, Sturm Faust, grenade launcher, electromagnetic wire, and so on.

52.DSCR:
A mass-production mobile suit of the $$ネオ・ジオン$$ forces.
As a squad leader's machine, it is equipped with the headdress traditional to $$ジオン$$.
Though given blue coloring as $$レズン$$'s personal machine, its performance differs little from that of standard-issue units, and its armaments are the same as well.

55.DSCR:
A Newtype-only mobile suit of the $$ネオ・ジオン$$ forces.
Developed at $$アナハイム・エレクトロニクス$$' $$グラナダ$$ plant. Two units were built as prototypes, and the red unit among them became $$クェス$$'s personal machine.
It adopts a $$サイコ・フレーム$$, giving it excellent control responsiveness and readiness.
Much of its armament, including its six funnels, is shared with $$ギュネイ$$'s machine, but $$クェス$$'s machine is equipped with a mega gatling gun.

56.DSCR:
A giant Newtype-only mobile armor of the $$ネオ・ジオン$$ forces.
It was developed with reference to psycommu-compatible machines such as the Elmeth and the $$キュベレイ$$.
Its main armaments include a mega particle cannon, twin vulcan guns, a wired psycommu-type mega arm cannon, funnels, and so on.
It was designed with anti-ship combat in mind, and possesses firepower to rival a warship. Its control relies on a $$サイコミュ$$, and its wired mega arm cannon and large funnels enable all-range attacks as well.
The huge Sturm Boosters on its legs can also be jettisoned after use.
With $$クェス$$ as its pilot, it was deployed as $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s trump card in the operation to cool the Earth.

57.DSCR:
A Newtype-only mobile suit of the $$ネオ・ジオン$$ forces.
The personal machine of Supreme Commander $$シャア・アズナブル$$, colored deep crimson.
By adopting a $$サイコ・フレーム$$, it achieved a level of responsiveness far beyond that of previous machine types. Despite its heavy armor, its many thrusters also give it high mobility, making it a powerful machine worthy of $$シャア$$.
Its main armaments -- a beam shot rifle, an abdominal mega particle cannon, a beam saber, funnels, and more -- give it overwhelming firepower that outclasses all others.

58.DSCR:
The flagship of the $$ネオ・ジオン$$ forces.
An evolution of the Gwazine-class battleship, formerly the flagship of the old $$ジオン公国$$ forces, inheriting its propulsion system, coolant tanks, and other features.
This ship's firepower and mobile suit capacity are the greatest of any vessel in either the $$ネオ・ジオン$$ or Earth Federation forces, and it fought as the core of the fleet during the $$第２次ネオ・ジオン抗争$$.

65.DSCR:
A variable mobile suit developed as the mainstay unit succeeding the $$リーオー$$.
Its name is drawn from '$$トーラス$$,' the bull of the twelve zodiac constellations.
Though developed as a mobile suit for space use, its variable transformation function lets it maintain high mobility even in operations within the atmosphere.
It can also carry a beam cannon capable of destroying even Gundanium alloy, and its performance surpasses the $$リーオー$$ and Aries in every respect.
The white-colored units were deployed to defend the $$サンクキングダム$$, used mainly by $$ノイン$$, and fought alongside the Gundams during the $$マリーメイア$$ Army's uprising as well.

66.DSCR:
The mobile armor form of the $$トーラス$$.
With the movable thrusters on its back serving as main wings, and using the thrusters on the soles of its feet, it can also fly under gravity.
Capable of high mobility, it excelled at hit-and-run tactics.

67.DSCR:
A derivative of the Tallgeese, developed on $$トレーズ$$ Khushrenada's orders.
It is a machine that retains the Tallgeese's extreme performance of 'high mobility, heavy armor,' while further reinforcing its offensive power.
True to that concept, its newly equipped Mega Cannon surpasses the Dover Gun in power, and at maximum output can destroy even a resource satellite in a single shot.
The Mega Cannon can also adjust its power by adjusting the length of its barrel, allowing for flexible tactics suited to the battlefield situation.
After the war it was kept under the management of the Preventers, but it was operated as $$ゼクス・マーキス$$'s mount during the $$マリーメイア$$ Army's uprising.

68.DSCR:
A mass-production heavy mobile suit that forms the mainstay of the $$マリーメイア$$ Army.
Developed by the $$バートン財団$$, which was also involved in developing the $$ガンダム$$ $$ヘビーアームズ$$.
A machine that excels at ranged combat, it can carry powerful ranged weapons such as the Double Gatling Gun and Beam Cannon, the same type used by the $$ガンダムヘビーアームズ改$$.
Its armor is also made from a new material said to match the hardness of Gundanium alloy, Neo-Titanium alloy, giving it high defensive power.
During the $$マリーメイア$$ Army's uprising, close to 400 units descended on Brussels and fought against the Gundams.

69.DSCR:
A mobile suit developed by the $$地球圏$$ Unified Nation.
Its name is drawn from '$$リーオー$$,' the lion of the twelve zodiac constellations.
Development prioritized mass-producibility and versatility, and it was mass-produced in greater numbers than any other unit by both the $$地球圏$$ Unified Nation and OZ.
It carries no fixed armament, making it a simple, quirk-free machine.
Though designed as a mobile suit for ground use, it can also be operated in space by swapping its backpack.
Having been used on the front lines for over twenty years since its development, many variants exist.

73.DSCR:
A state-of-the-art mobile suit developed alongside the Infinite Justice at '$$ファクトリー$$,' the base of the Clyne Faction, the anti-$$デュランダル$$ faction.
It is equipped with a new-model laser fusion engine, boasting several times the output of the Freedom.
Its newly equipped 'Super Dragoon (Mobile Weapon System)' separates the wing sections that boost its mobility and uses them as wirelessly guided beam weapons. On its first sortie, it used this new weapon to disable a total of 25 ZAKU Warriors and GOUF Ignited units in just two minutes.
Its armor has also been changed to VPS armor, and it even has built-in beam shields, making it a machine with no openings to exploit in either offense or defense.
However, bringing out its full power requires a high level of piloting skill, and it is said to be difficult for anyone other than $$キラ$$ to operate.

74.DSCR:
The form taken when the $$オーライザー$$, a support unit, combines with the 00 Gundam, $$ソレスタルビーイング$$'s fourth-generation $$ガンダム$$ piloted by $$刹那・Ｆ・セイエイ$$.
The 00 Gundam was developed with the $$ツインドライヴ$$ system as a premise, but because synchronizing its two GN Drives proved difficult, it was operated docked with the $$オーライザー$$, which was given the role of a control unit.
During Trans-Am, it demonstrated performance beyond its original design specs, among other things generating a shared consciousness space through the GN particles it released.
For this reason, the 'Gundam' was dropped from its name, and it was christened '$$ダブルオーライザー$$,' as 'something that surpasses the $$ガンダム$$.'
After its original $$ＧＮドライヴ$$ was destroyed in the battle against the Innovades, it has been operated since the war's end with a particle storage tank installed in place of the $$ＧＮドライヴ$$. Even in this state its basic performance is not inferior, and Trans-Am remains possible, though its activation time has become extremely short.

76.DSCR:
$$ソレスタルビーイング$$'s fifth-generation $$ガンダム$$, inheriting the lineage of the Cherudim $$ガンダム$$.
Piloted by $$ロックオン・ストラトス$$.
The Dynames and Cherudim before it were developed as sniper-specialized machines to make use of their pilots' aptitudes, but this unit has been redesigned to enable omnidirectional fire, taking into account combat against numerous opponents.
Its main armament is multiple GN Rifle Bits II, usable both as rifles and as pistols. These can also be used as remotely guided weapons and deployed simultaneously. Furthermore, the holsters that store these rifles can themselves be deployed as shield bits.
It also carries GN Micro Missiles throughout its body, improving its firepower.
Its increasingly complex fire control is supported by $$ハロ$$ units, increased to two, allowing all of these weapons to be used at the same time.
With this equipment, this unit is completed as a bombardment-type mobile suit capable of responding at any range.

proofread.reason: omission: the Japanese 2台に増設したハロ says the Haro were expanded/increased to two units; the English only said 'two Haro units' and dropped the increase

81.DSCR:
A multipurpose ship that serves as the starting point for $$ソレスタルビーイング$$'s operations.
Foreseeing the shift of the times toward space development after the war against the Innovades, it underwent modifications aimed at long-range voyages.
Its basic performance remains that of the $$プトレマイオス２$$, but it has been fitted with an additional long-range, detachable large booster that integrates a GN Condenser into its main thrusters. This has greatly strengthened its cruising capability.

82.DSCR:
The $$プトレマイオス２改$$ in its Trans-Am state.
Its mobility and maneuverability are dramatically improved, and the GN particles it releases can also be used as a barrier.
In the case of the unmodified $$プトレマイオス２$$, Trans-Am relied on GN particles from its storage tank, making sustained activation impossible. After the refit, however, system optimization has greatly extended its activation time.

93.DSCR:
A prototype mobile suit that was secretly under development at $$アナハイム・エレクトロニクス$$.
A machine colored pure white all over, with a single horn on its head reminiscent of a unicorn.
Its movable frame is formed entirely of $$サイコ・フレーム$$, giving it extraordinarily high control responsiveness.
Its armament is also powerful; its main weapon, the Beam Magnum, delivers the power of four ordinary beam rifle shots in a single blast. However, it has the drawback of needing to eject an energy pack after every shot, meaning it can only fire five shots even carrying a full load of packs. Besides this, it can mount abundant optional equipment, such as the Hyper Bazooka, suited to the battlefield situation.
This unit was developed as the core of the Federation's top-secret 'Unicorn Project,' and much information about it remains classified. So thorough is this secrecy that even those involved in its development cannot grasp anything outside their own assigned area.
Its cockpit is fitted with a biometric authentication system, and no one but $$バナージ・リンクス$$, the first person registered to it, can operate it.

102.DSCR:
A mobile suit developed for the mass production of the $$Ｚガンダム$$.
Where the $$リ・ガズィ$$ substituted a BWS (Back Weapon System) for a variable mechanism, this unit simplifies matters by adopting the $$メタス$$'s variable mechanism instead.
By sharing actuators and internal electronics as much as possible, costs were reduced, and it was completed as the first variable mobile suit of the GM and $$ジェガン$$ lineage.
Its weapons and backpack can be swapped according to mission requirements; besides standard armaments such as the beam rifle and beam saber, it can also carry large weapons such as the mega beam launcher.
The only visible difference between the squad leader's unit and standard units is color: the leader's unit has green sensors, with its chest and legs in dark gray.

proofread.reason: addition: the Japanese says 'large weapons' (daigata kaki); 'large-caliber' is not in the source

103.DSCR:
The $$リゼル$$'s cruising configuration.
By converging the thrusters throughout the unit's body toward the rear, it achieves high mobility. Its weapons are mounted facing forward, so they remain usable even in this configuration.
The backpack on its rear has grips for mobile suits to hold onto, and by making use of its surplus thrust, it can also be operated as a sub flight system.

105.DSCR:
A variable mobile suit developed by $$アナハイム・エレクトロニクス$$.
Although originally designed as a variable unit, the Hyaku Shiki was completed as a fixed-form unit due to frame strength problems; this unit reexamines that shortcoming, and was redesigned incorporating the technical strengths of the $$Ｚガンダム$$, such as the bio-sensor.
As a result, it became capable of transforming into $$ウェイブ・ライダー$$ mode, and was completed as an all-purpose attack unit with flight capability under gravity and atmospheric reentry capability, able to operate in every domain.
However, due to the cost problems common to variable units, and to the many non-standard parts used in its construction, it never reached mass production, and only a small number were built.
Because these characteristics make it difficult to incorporate into standard unit formations, it was assigned to the similarly non-standard $$ネェル・アーガマ$$, where $$リディ・マーセナス$$ served as its pilot.

106.DSCR:
The $$デルタプラス$$'s $$ウェイブ・ライダー$$ configuration.
Capable of independent atmospheric reentry and flight under gravity.
It was designed with the aim of further developing the $$Ｚガンダム$$'s variable functionality, and improves its aerial combat performance through features such as the flexible binders that serve as variable wings, and thrusters concentrated toward the rear.
The part used as a shield in mobile suit mode becomes the nose cone in this configuration, with sensors, a beam cannon, grenades, and other weapons mounted at its tip.

110.DSCR:
A successor to the Argama-class, built during the First Neo Zeon War.
Its name means 'one close to the $$アーガマ$$.'
During the First Neo Zeon War, it carried cutting-edge units led by the ZZ $$ガンダム$$, becoming a major force in bringing the conflict to an end.
After the war ended, it underwent a large-scale refit, expanding the volume of its catapult block and modernizing its armaments.
It belongs to the $$ロンド・ベル$$ fleet, but its lack of compatibility from having no sister ships, along with performance characteristics unsuited to fleet formations, mean it is mainly operated alone on special missions.

111.DSCR:
A mobile suit exclusive to $$フル・フロンタル$$.
The $$袖付き$$ seized a prototype mobile suit under development by $$アナハイム・エレクトロニクス$$, and operate it after applying their own modifications and decoration.
It is an experimental unit using a $$サイコ・フレーム$$ in its movable frame, and the data obtained from it also proved useful in the development of the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$.
It is also said that, in order to test its limit performance, it was not even designed on the assumption that a human would board it, and thanks to the responsiveness afforded by the $$サイコ・フレーム$$ and the mobility gained from its two pairs of flexible thrusters, reminiscent of wings, it boasts overwhelming combat power.
Its speed and crimson coloring bring to mind the 'Red Comet' in the eyes of those who see it.

proofread.reason: mistranslation: the Japanese has a purpose clause (to test the limit performance, a human boarding was not even assumed); the English turned it into 'performance was tested without assuming a pilot', losing the purpose and the design decision

114.DSCR:
The $$袖付き$$' main mobile suit, developed by $$アナハイム・エレクトロニクス$$ based on the $$ギラ・ドーガ$$.
With its green coloring and mono-eye, it follows the line of previous Zeon-derived main mobile suits, and features a gas-mask-like structure around its mouth. Its arms bear the decoration that gave rise to the name 'the $$袖付き$$.'
Its overall performance is improved over the $$ギラ・ドーガ$$, but the unit's greatest strength lies in its versatility. It has an abundance of variations, and can be equipped for various operations by swapping equipment according to the situation.
Because of this, to the $$袖付き$$, whose scale amounts to no more than what would be classified as a terrorist organization, this unit holds value beyond simply being a powerful mobile suit.

115.DSCR:
A variant of the $$ギラ・ズール$$ piloted by $$フロンタル$$'s honor guard.
Due to the need to coordinate closely with $$フル・フロンタル$$, its output has been increased compared to the standard $$ギラ・ズール$$.
In addition, both shoulders have been changed to spikes, and the decorations applied to each part have become more elaborate.

116.DSCR:
The $$ギラ・ズール$$ piloted by $$アンジェロ・ザウパー$$.
It is painted in his personal color, purple.
Like the other honor guard units, its output has been increased, both shoulders have been changed to spikes, and the decorations applied to each part have become more elaborate.
Its equipment is changed according to the mission, using either the long-range beam weapon Runge Bruno Cannon Kai or the beam shot rifle.

118.DSCR:
A mobile suit independently developed by the $$ジオン$$ remnant Delaz Fleet.
It is closer to a modification than to fresh development, a stopgap unit assembled by diverting parts from $$一年戦争$$-era weapons.
However, its mobility in outer space is high, and it was judged that it could serve as a fighting force in certain situations, so a certain number were produced.
The unit the $$袖付き$$ deployed at $$パラオ$$ is presumed to be one that survived from that era, but repairs and modifications have been made to various parts, including its coloring and equipment.

119.DSCR:
A mobile suit developed by $$ネオ・ジオン$$ forces during the First Neo Zeon War for the Earth invasion operation.
It boasts stable, high performance, and its Gundarium alloy armor and high-output generator are not inferior even compared to mobile suits of the U.C. 0096 era. Because of this, it is a valuable asset to the $$袖付き$$, who are short on military strength.
As built-in weapons, it carries a triple-tube beam gun and a launchable slashing weapon called the Tri-Blade on its arms. It can also be equipped with the Giant Bazooka, newly developed based on the $$シナンジュ$$'s bazooka, as an option.

proofread.reason: mistranslation: the Japanese says the Sleeves are lacking in military strength/forces (senryoku no toboshii); 'resource-poor' shifts the meaning to resources

121.DSCR:
A derivative of the Gallus-J, developed by $$ネオ・ジオン$$ forces during the First Neo Zeon War for ground invasion use.
Fixed weapons such as the finger missiles and shoulder missiles have been omitted, replaced with the Ga-Zowmine's hyper knuckle buster mounted on the shoulder.
Both arms are fitted with multi-purpose hardpoints; the unit that attacked $$トリントン基地$$ had a Zaku Cannon's big gun mounted on its right arm and a triple missile pod on its left.

122.DSCR:
The final production specification of the Dom, developed by the $$ジオン公国$$ during the final stages of the $$一年戦争$$.
With enlarged rear thrusters and thrusters installed inside its skirt, it has nearly twice the thrust of the Dom.
It was deployed mainly around Africa and West Asia, and surviving units continued to be operated with modifications by $$ジオン$$ remnant forces; records show it was used by the Blue Team and the African Liberation Front during the First Neo Zeon War as well.
Its participation from the West Asia region was also confirmed during the raid on $$トリントン基地$$.

123.DSCR:
A mobile suit said to have been developed by the $$ジオン公国$$ for the assault on Jaburo during the $$一年戦争$$.
Equipped with a triple-tube rocket launcher on each arm and four beam cannons on its chest, it was developed with fire support as its concept.
It is also an extremely sturdy unit; when it struck an enemy mobile suit with its arm-mounted rocket launcher, the impact was enough to crush the opponent's armor.

124.DSCR:
An amphibious mobile suit developed by the $$ジオン公国$$.
It adopts both water-cooling and air-cooling systems, delivering high performance in both underwater and land engagements. Its mono-eye also rotates a full 360 degrees, leaving no blind spots in its field of view.
Its arms are equipped with mega particle cannons and claws, so melee combat is also anticipated.
As the completed form of the amphibious mobile suit line, derivative units were also developed.
During the $$一年戦争$$ it was finished in a blue-based coloring, but the units of the $$ジオン$$ remnant forces that cooperated with the $$袖付き$$ were painted in green tones.

125.DSCR:
A technical test unit modified from the Byarlant, a mobile suit owned by the $$ティターンズ$$ during the $$グリプス戦役$$.
It has been modified with an emphasis on extending flight time within the atmosphere, with reinforced thrusters throughout and additional propellant tanks.
Its small arm-mounted claws have also been enlarged by replacing them with the Gaplant's claw arms, improving its melee capabilities as well.
Its combat power is high; in the battle at $$トリントン基地$$, it destroyed $$ジオン$$ remnant mobile suits one after another.

126.DSCR:
A space cargo ship operated by the $$袖付き$$, disguised as a civilian freighter.
It can carry up to four mobile suits, and has atmospheric reentry capability and flight capability under gravity.
As it is normally operated as a shuttle transport vessel, it carries no weapons to speak of, aside from rockets for destroying debris.
Its hull bears the disguise markings 'Ribacona Cargo.'
It made port at $$インダストリアル７$$ under orders to receive $$ラプラスの箱$$.

It made port at $$インダストリアル７$$ under orders to receive $$ラプラスの箱$$.

128.DSCR:
The smallest of the $$宇宙怪獣$$, of the 10m class. Its official scientific name is 'Babolar.'
It parasitizes inside a Landing Craft, and is released to fight after the Landing Craft carries out its assault.
Its numbers are the greatest of any type, but it possesses neither reproductive nor digestive organs, and dies out two to three hours after being released.

129.DSCR:
A cone-shaped Space Monster. Its interior houses a large number of soldiers.
It normally clings densely, like thorns, to the surface of a Cruiser-class, but upon spotting an enemy, it detaches from the Cruiser-class and charges forward at high acceleration. The instant it pierces its target, it releases the soldiers within to overwhelm it; this is its method of attack.
Multi-stage boosters are fitted to its rear, increasing the force of its charge.

proofread.reason: omission/mistranslation: the Japanese says it is packed tightly (bisshiri) onto the Cruiser-class body like thorns (plural); 'like a thorn' dropped the density and number

130.DSCR:
The individuals that form the core of the $$宇宙怪獣$$.
Starting with individuals of this size, they are capable of independent warp.
They can move at near-light speed, and are equipped with light spheres and giant fireball cannons capable of sinking even a space battleship in a single blow, making them a threat even alone. In addition to this, they attack while releasing large numbers of soldiers.
Among individuals of this size, the type known as the high-speed type is somewhat smaller than other individuals of the same class and inferior in firepower, but boasts high mobility. A large-capacity cooling organ that trails in the ether current is attached to its rear.

144.DSCR:
The fighter mode of a unit that $$バサラ$$ remodeled to his own preferred design from the VF-19C, which was developed under the military's 'Project M,' a program researching $$歌エネルギー$$. Commonly known as the Fire Valkyrie.
It is equipped with a special piloting system called the Sound Stick System, and is controlled using a control stick shaped like a guitar.
Its performance is close to that of the prototype YF-19, rivaling the military's standard-issue units, and combined with $$バサラ$$'s genius technique, it flew freely across the battlefield in every direction.

145.DSCR:
The fighter mode of a variable fighter officially adopted by the $$マクロス７$$ fleet.
It is based on the YF-21, which once competed against the YF-19.
The brainwave control system that was the YF-21's greatest feature has been removed, replaced with a cockpit supporting visual flight and manual control. These changes achieved a major reduction in cost and a lighter airframe.
Thanks to its lighter weight and main wings capable of changing shape, it possesses mobility rivaling that of the prototype YF-21.
$$ガムリン$$ used this unit to pursue $$バサラ$$ to the planet Zola, joining the battle between the Zola garrison's Galaxy Patrol and the Galaxy Whale poaching fleet.

146.DSCR:
The Battroid mode of a variable fighter officially adopted by the $$マクロス７$$ fleet.
It is based on the YF-21, which once competed against the YF-19.
The brainwave control system that was the YF-21's greatest feature has been removed, replaced with a cockpit supporting visual flight and manual control. These changes achieved a major reduction in cost and a lighter airframe.
Zentraedi technology has also been applied, and like the prototype YF-21, its design resembles that of a Battle Suit.
$$ガムリン$$ used this unit to pursue $$バサラ$$ to the planet Zola, joining the battle between the Zola garrison's Galaxy Patrol and the Galaxy Whale poaching fleet.

147.DSCR:
A vanguard unit of the VF-25 $$メサイア$$ series. Its Fighter mode equipped with the Tornado Pack, atmospheric-use specification.
In $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, $$アルト$$ pilots this unit.
The VF-25 $$メサイア$$ is the latest multirole variable fighter, a unit jointly developed by the private companies L.A.I. and Shinsei Industry based on the YF-24, a prototype developed by the New United Nations Spacy. It is operated by $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ in the form of evaluation testing prior to official military deployment.
The Tornado Pack is a state-of-the-art reinforcement pack that adds equipment such as a rotary twin beam gun and rotary engine pods to the VF-25. Equipping this pack not only increases firepower, but also greatly improves mobility and maneuverability.
Normally, rotating the twin beam gun's long barrel within the atmosphere would cause aerodynamic problems, but these are resolved by using the movable engine pods to compensate for changes in airflow.
Thanks to these engine pods, the Tornado Pack grants the VF-25 even higher aerial combat mobility than when equipped with the Super Pack.

149.DSCR:
A vanguard unit of the VF-25 $$メサイア$$ series. Its Fighter mode equipped with the Tornado Pack, exo-atmospheric specification.
In $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, $$アルト$$ pilots this unit.
The VF-25 $$メサイア$$ is the latest multirole variable fighter, a unit jointly developed by the private companies L.A.I. and Shinsei Industry based on the YF-24, a prototype developed by the New United Nations Spacy. It is operated by $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ in the form of evaluation testing prior to official military deployment.
The Tornado Pack is a state-of-the-art reinforcement pack that adds equipment such as a rotary twin beam gun and rotary engine pods to the VF-25. Equipping this pack not only increases firepower, but also greatly improves mobility and maneuverability.
In exo-atmospheric operation, a propellant auxiliary tank that doubles as an atmospheric reentry fairing is attached to the tip of the engine pods.

151.DSCR:
The long-range sniper unit of the VF-25 $$メサイア$$ series. Its Fighter mode equipped with the Tornado Pack, atmospheric-use specification.
In $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, $$ミシェル$$ pilots this unit.
Its dedicated sniper rifle can be used even in this configuration, but it must transform to Battroid mode for precision fire.

152.DSCR:
The long-range sniper unit of the VF-25 $$メサイア$$ series. Its Battroid mode equipped with the Tornado Pack, atmospheric-use specification.
In $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, $$ミシェル$$ pilots this unit.
Its head main camera is a monocular type built for long-range shooting. Combined with the Sniper Pack and the gunner kit integrated into its EX-Gear, it is capable of highly precise sniping.

153.DSCR:
The long-range sniper unit of the VF-25 $$メサイア$$ series. Its Fighter mode equipped with the Tornado Pack, exo-atmospheric specification.
In $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, $$ミシェル$$ pilots this unit.
Its dedicated sniper rifle can be used even in this configuration, but it must transform to Battroid mode for precision fire.

154.DSCR:
The long-range sniper unit of the VF-25 $$メサイア$$ series. Its Battroid mode equipped with the Tornado Pack, exo-atmospheric specification.
In $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, $$ミシェル$$ pilots this unit.
Its head main camera is a monocular type built for long-range shooting. Combined with the Sniper Pack and the gunner kit integrated into its EX-Gear, it is capable of highly precise sniping.

155.DSCR:
The electronic warfare unit of the VF-25 $$メサイア$$ series. Its Fighter mode.
In $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, Ruuca pilots this unit.
It is equipped with numerous radars and sensors, specialized for reconnaissance and electronic warfare.
It comes standard with an improved Aegis Pack, and mounts a large composite-type radome on the upper part of its airframe. Since the radome detects targets using Fold Waves, it is capable of ultra-high-speed reconnaissance. In space, its circumferential section is deployed for use.
Through its advanced electronic warfare capability, it serves as the eyes and ears of $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$
While it carries a great deal of radar equipment, its firepower is lacking, so Ruuca fights by remotely directing the unmanned drone Ghost QF-4000.

156.DSCR:
The electronic warfare unit of the VF-25 $$メサイア$$ series. Its Battroid mode.
In $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, Ruuca pilots this unit.
It is equipped with numerous radars and sensors, specialized for reconnaissance and electronic warfare.
Its head mounts a high-performance sensor, and the laser machine guns equipped on the F and S types have been replaced with high-precision antennas. In addition, the weight of the composite-type radome mounted on its back makes it poorly suited to direct combat, but Ruuca compensates for this lack of combat ability by remotely directing the unmanned drone Ghost QF-4000.
Through its advanced electronic warfare capability, it serves as the eyes and ears of $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$

157.DSCR:
The electronic warfare unit of the VF-25 $$メサイア$$ series. Its Fighter mode equipped with the Super Pack.
In $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, Ruuca pilots this unit.
It is equipped with numerous radars and sensors, specialized for reconnaissance and electronic warfare.
It comes standard with an improved Aegis Pack, and mounts a large composite-type radome on the upper part of its airframe. Since the radome detects targets using Fold Waves, it is capable of ultra-high-speed reconnaissance. In space, its circumferential section is deployed for use.
Through its advanced electronic warfare capability, it serves as the eyes and ears of $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$
While it carries a great deal of radar equipment, its firepower is lacking, so Ruuca fights by remotely directing the unmanned drone Ghost QF-4000.
Equipping the Super Pack not only improves its mobility in space, but also increases its firepower.

158.DSCR:
The electronic warfare variant of the VF-25 $$メサイア$$ series. This is its Battroid Mode equipped with the Super Pack.
In $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, Ruuca pilots this unit.
It carries numerous radars and sensors, making it a machine specialized for reconnaissance and electronic warfare.
The head is fitted with a high-performance sensor, and the laser machine guns mounted on the F and S types have been replaced with a high-precision antenna. The weight of the composite radome mounted on its back also works against it, making it unsuited to direct combat, but Ruuca compensates for this lack of combat ability by remotely controlling and guiding the unmanned Ghost QF-4000.
Equipping the Super Pack not only improves its mobility in space but also increases its firepower.

159.DSCR:
The commander's unit of the VF-25 $$メサイア$$ series. This is the Atmospheric Type of its Fighter Mode, equipped with the Tornado Pack.
In $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, the squad leader $$オズマ$$ pilots this unit.
Compared to other models, its output, firepower, and other performance figures have all been improved, and as a commander's unit it has also been fitted with enhanced communication and command functions as well as a program to assist with command of operations.

160.DSCR:
The commander's unit of the VF-25 $$メサイア$$ series. This is the Atmospheric Type of its Battroid Mode, equipped with the Tornado Pack.
In $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, the squad leader $$オズマ$$ pilots this unit.
Compared to other models, its output, firepower, and other performance figures have all been improved, and as a commander's unit it has also been fitted with enhanced communication and command functions as well as a program to assist with command of operations.

161.DSCR:
The commander's unit of the VF-25 $$メサイア$$ series. This is the Space Type of its Fighter Mode, equipped with the Tornado Pack.
In $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, the squad leader $$オズマ$$ pilots this unit.
Compared to other models, its output, firepower, and other performance figures have all been improved, and as a commander's unit it has also been fitted with enhanced communication and command functions as well as a program to assist with command of operations.

The commander's unit of the VF-25 $$メサイア$$ series. This is the Space Type of its Battroid Mode, equipped with the Tornado Pack.
In $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, the squad leader $$オズマ$$ pilots this unit.
Compared to other models, its output, firepower, and other performance figures have all been improved, and as a commander's unit it has also been fitted with enhanced communication and command functions as well as a program to assist with command of operations.

163.DSCR:
The $$クァドラン・レア$$ piloted by $$クラン$$.
The squad leader's unit of the $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ Pixie Squadron, distinguished by its deep crimson coloring.
It is a remanufactured, technologically updated version of the Queadluun-Rau, the highly mobile aerial combat pod used by female Zentraedi soldiers during the $$第一次星間大戦$$. Its outward appearance resembles the Rau, but the Rea incorporates functions and equipment that place a greater emphasis on pilot survivability. Its mobility and firepower rival even the latest-model VF-25, and it displays especially outstanding ability in close-quarters combat.
Its armaments include missile launcher pods and Impact Cannons on its back, as well as triple-barrel Gatling laser pulse guns on its arms.

165.DSCR:
An all-purpose space combat carrier that serves as the flagship of $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$.
It is the largest combat vessel the private company $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ has been permitted to possess, and its captain is Colonel $$ジェフリー・ワイルダー$$.
True to the name 'Quarter,' its size is roughly one-quarter that of a Macross-class ship, and it has higher mobility than that class. As its 'all-purpose' name suggests, it is capable of Fold navigation, independent descent to a planet's surface, flight within the atmosphere, and travel both on and under water.
It carries numerous weapons, including a Gunship (rapid-fire Buster Cannon), eight Quarter Cannons, anti-ship missiles, and anti-air missile launchers.
It is also capable of transforming into the Assault Type configuration, the greatest characteristic of the Macross-class.

166.DSCR:
The Assault Type configuration of the $$マクロス・クォーター$$.
It transforms from the Fortress Ship Type through the activation of its Transformation sequence.
The Gunship, equipped with a triple rapid-fire Buster Cannon, is mounted on the right arm, while the carrier's flight deck, which also doubles as a shield, is mounted on the left arm.
The Gunship's heavy quantum reaction cannon mode is operated in this configuration. Quarter Cannons are also positioned on the chest and shoulders, allowing firepower to be concentrated to the front.
This configuration also boasts tremendous attack power in close-quarters combat. Its most distinctive attack method is the 'Macross Attack,' in which Pinpoint Barriers are concentrated at the carrier's bow to pierce an enemy ship's armor, after which a Destroid unit is deployed inside.

167.DSCR:
This is the Atmospheric Type of the YF-29 $$デュランダル$$'s Fighter Mode, equipped with the Super Pack.
$$アルト$$ pilots this unit.
A prototype developed for decisive battle against the $$バジュラ$$, designed on the basis of the VF-25. Engineers from L.A.I. and the $$マクロス・フロンティア船団$$, among others, took part in its development.
Its greatest feature is that it carries the 'Fold Wave System.' This system uses Fold Quartz gathered from $$バジュラ$$ remains, and enables an almost inexhaustible energy supply. This made it possible to dramatically raise attack power, energy shield capability, and other performance figures far above those of previous machines.
Although a prototype, this unit is equipped with the Super Pack. It consists of Fold Wave projectors at the tips of both wings, chemical rocket boosters at the rear of the inner wings, and other components. Its additional armor is limited to a shield made of laminated energy conversion armor, with the emphasis placed on amplifying the Fold Wave and boosting mobility.
In the atmosphere, the space propellant pods that cover the Super Pack's engine pods are jettisoned.

Its greatest feature is that it carries the 'Fold Wave System.' This system uses Fold Quartz gathered from $$バジュラ$$ remains, and enables an almost inexhaustible energy supply. This made it possible to dramatically raise attack power, energy shield capability, and other performance figures far above those of previous machines.
Although a prototype, this unit is equipped with the Super Pack. It consists of Fold Wave projectors at the tips of both wings, chemical rocket boosters at the rear of the inner wings, and other components. Its additional armor is limited to a shield made of laminated energy conversion armor, with the emphasis placed on amplifying the Fold Wave and boosting mobility.
In space, space propellant pods are added to the front of the Super Pack's outer wing engine pods.

170.DSCR:
This is the Space Type of the YF-29 $$デュランダル$$'s Battroid Mode, equipped with the Super Pack.
$$アルト$$ pilots this unit.
A prototype developed for decisive battle against the $$バジュラ$$, designed on the basis of the VF-25. Engineers from L.A.I. and the $$マクロス・フロンティア船団$$, among others, took part in its development.
Its greatest feature is that it carries the 'Fold Wave System.' This system uses Fold Quartz gathered from $$バジュラ$$ remains, and enables an almost inexhaustible energy supply. This made it possible to dramatically raise attack power, energy shield capability, and other performance figures far above those of previous machines.
Although a prototype, this unit is equipped with the Super Pack. It consists of Fold Wave projectors at the tips of both wings, chemical rocket boosters at the rear of the inner wings, and other components. Its additional armor is limited to a shield made of laminated energy conversion armor, with the emphasis placed on amplifying the Fold Wave and boosting mobility.

173.DSCR:
An unmanned fighter that serves as the main strength of the $$ギャラクシー船団$$.
Its official designation is $$ＡＩＦ－９Ｖ$$.
Being an unmanned drone, it is not designed with pilot safety in mind, and boasts a level of mobility impossible for a manned machine. However, due to a past incident, restrictions have been placed on the operation of unmanned drones, and the use of this unit, which possesses the highest combat strength of the Ghost series, is severely restricted.

174.DSCR:
A small trooper-type $$バジュラ$$.
The most numerous of the $$バジュラ$$, it mainly acts in the company of larger $$バジュラ$$.
It has high mobility, and although it has no wings, it can fly even within the atmosphere. It is also capable of biological Fold navigation, albeit only over short distances.
It attacks using pulse beams fired from the crystalline structure of its torso, as well as its anchor-shaped head and whip-like tail.

176.DSCR:
A large trooper-type $$バジュラ$$.
Each swarm numbers anywhere from several thousand to tens of thousands of individuals.
The ram-like protrusion on its back is a bio heavy beam cannon, and the high-output energy it fires rivals that of a space cruiser. It also has an outer shell of energy conversion armor, giving it excellent defensive ability.
It is also agile in its movements, using wing-like organs to operate both in space and within the atmosphere. It is likewise capable of biological Fold navigation over short distances.

178.DSCR:
A type of $$バジュラ$$, also known as the Hound $$バジュラ$$.
A rare species with fewer individuals compared to other $$バジュラ$$. It performs a commander-like role and carries out reconnaissance in force. Despite being a large individual, its wings give it extremely high flight ability within the atmosphere.
It fights using a bio heavy beam cannon, biological micro-missiles with tracking capability, and the enormous scythes on its forearms.

proofread.reason: mistranslation: 強行偵察 is 'reconnaissance in force', not 'forced reconnaissance' (robot 179 already uses this term for the identical sentence)

182.DSCR:
A $$バジュラ$$ that serves as the flagship within a combat group.
Each group numbers around ten to twenty individuals.
On the battlefield, countless large and small $$バジュラ$$ deploy around it to serve as its escort.
The triple bio heavy quantum beam cannon on its back and elsewhere is extremely powerful, with output rivaling that of a Macross Cannon. It is also equipped with bio energy conversion armor and a field barrier, giving it formidable defensive strength.
It is capable of biological Fold navigation, allowing it to travel across extremely long distances.

184.DSCR:
A $$バジュラ$$ in the form of a combat ship.
Each group numbers roughly several hundred individuals.
It is about the same size as the $$マクロス・クォーター$$, but has high mobility, and travels extremely long distances via biological Fold navigation.

187.DSCR:
The final Getter Robo, developed for aerial combat.
The Getter Battle Wing on its back generates anti-gravity to enable flight. Its shape changes depending on the situation, for example prioritizing top speed or aerial maneuverability.
It excels at melee combat using the Getter Tomahawk and Getter Scythe, but of the three $$真ゲッター$$ configurations, only $$真ゲッター１$$ can fire the Getter Beam, the weapon most effective against the Invaders. The beam fired from its abdomen is also more powerful than the one fired from its forehead.
Its ultimate finishing move is Stoner Sunshine, which draws out the power of $$ゲッター線$$.

188.DSCR:
The final Getter Robo, developed for ground and underground combat.
It boasts extraordinary speed, and excels at charging tactics using the massive drill mounted on its right arm.
Another characteristic is that nearly all of its techniques, including Drill Missile, Drill Hurricane, and Plasma Drill Hurricane, make use of the drill.

189.DSCR:
The final Getter Robo, developed for underwater combat.
Making use of its power, it also displays high combat ability during operations on land.
It is equipped with missiles all over its body: Getter Missiles and Homing Missiles at the shoulders, and Missile Storm at the rear, enabling it to fight at both long and close range.

190.DSCR:
The final form of Shin Dragon.
$$號$$ had died once, but sensing $$渓$$'s crisis, he was revived, evolved Shin Dragon into its final form, and ascended into space.
It possesses a Getter Beam powerful enough to destroy even Jupiter's moon Ganymede in a single blast, and can also transform into Shin Liger and Shin Poseidon. However, this transformation is not achieved by separation and combination, but pivots around the cylindrical section at its center.
Combining its strength with $$真ゲッター$$, it succeeded in defeating the colossal $$コーウェン$$ and $$スティンガー$$, but immediately afterward a rift in spacetime appeared, one large enough to swallow even Pluto.
To stop it, Shin Dragon activated its ultimate weapon, Shin Shine Spark, sending $$竜馬$$ and the others into the space between time.

proofread.reason: omitted subject: the whole entry has Shin Dragon as the agent, and 最終兵器・真シャインスパークを発動させて...送った is its own act, so the passive 'was activated' hid the actor; the machine is named because a bare 'it' would be ambiguous with the spacetime rift

191.DSCR:
A machine built by $$竜馬$$, after being sent forward into the future, by repairing and rebuilding a Getter 1 that had lain decaying on the surface of the moon. It seats one pilot and cannot separate or combine.
It was originally the same color as an ordinary Getter, but its paint was scorched black during atmospheric reentry.
It had its energy absorbed by the awakening Shin Dragon and fell into the sea. It has not appeared since, as $$竜馬$$ subsequently switched to Shin Getter.

192.DSCR:
A lower-class Invader active in space.
Its behavioral principles, purpose, and origin are unknown, and since it has no means of communication, it is an enemy that threatens humanity's very survival.
Its intelligence is low, but its aggression is high, and it repeats a cycle of finding prey, devouring it, and reproducing.
The bacteria that are the Invaders' predecessor are single-celled microorganisms also known as fission bacteria. The way they multiply solely through binary fission or endospore formation, and parasitize others to cause fermentation and decay, is precisely the nature of the Invaders themselves.

193.DSCR:
An Invader that appeared near Jupiter.
It is far larger than the ones that appeared on the ground, and is distinguished by a shape resembling an ancient Earth creature.
It tormented the Getter Team through sheer numbers.

194.DSCR:
An Invader that appeared near Jupiter.
It is far larger than the ones that appeared on the ground, and is distinguished by a shape resembling a marine creature.
It tormented the Getter Team through sheer numbers.

198.DSCR:
The successor to Aphrodai A.
Since it was built from the start as a combat unit, its combat strength is dramatically greater than that of Aphrodai A.
Its appearance was designed based on its pilot, $$さやか$$, herself, and its styling has also been considerably improved.
It is also capable of flight, and in addition to the Photon Power Beam, it is equipped with Super Alloy Z cutters on both arms.
In the final battle it fought valiantly, but was captured by $$ブロッケン$$ V2 Schneider, the $$機械獣$$ controlled by $$ブロッケン伯爵$$. Though it fell into a desperate, life-threatening crisis, it escaped danger with support from the Science Fortress Institute.

199.DSCR:
A former work robot from the Photon Power Lab, remodeled and repainted. It was named $$ボスボロット$$ by $$ヌケ$$ and $$ムチャ$$, a shortening of '$$ボス$$'s Robot.'
Though comical in appearance, it put in noteworthy performances, such as bear-hugging a missile-type $$機械獣$$ and hurling it into the sky.
In the final battle, it made a desperate, do-or-die charge at the $$機械獣$$ $$あしゅら男爵$$, but was deflected and exploded, leaving only its head intact. Using just its head, it hauled up $$マジンガーＺ$$, which had sunk to the ocean floor, and delivered it to $$甲児$$.

200.DSCR:
A $$機械獣$$ that appeared in Episode 9, 'Activate! Operation Invade Japan!'
In addition to breathing fire, it also delivers powerful attacks with the chained iron balls on both arms. It shrugged off the attacks of the Super Robot corps without effect, and even fought $$マジンガーＺ$$ to a standstill in coordination with Toros D7.
When it tried to ensnare $$マジンガーＺ$$ with its iron balls, it instead lost the contest of strength and was swung around. After being made to collide with Toros D7, it was wiped out along with its ally by Breast Fire.

201.DSCR:
A $$機械獣$$ that appeared in Episode 24, 'Line of Death! All-Out Attack, $$Ｄｒ．ヘル$$!'
It stood in the way of $$マジンガーＺ$$ as it headed for a one-on-one duel with $$あしゅら男爵$$.
It excels at attacking with bow and arrow, and the arrows loosed from its bow fly faster than Rust Hurricane.
Working together with fellow Mechanical Beasts, it drove $$マジンガーＺ$$ into a corner, but had its torso pierced by the Rocket Punch of $$マジンガーＺ$$ after it combined with $$ゴッドスクランダー$$.

202.DSCR:
A flying $$機械獣$$ that appeared in Episode 23, 'Closing In! The $$機械獣$$, $$あしゅら男爵$$!'
By spinning the huge fan at the center of its body, it would suck in its opponents and then crush them, an attack with which it wiped out an entire Self-Defense Force fighter squadron.

203.DSCR:
A $$機械獣$$ that appeared in Episode 24, 'Line of Death! All-Out Attack, $$Ｄｒ．ヘル$$!'
It stood in the way of $$マジンガーＺ$$ as it headed for a one-on-one duel with $$あしゅら男爵$$.
It emitted powerful electromagnetic waves from a device on its shoulder to manipulate gravity, lifting $$マジンガーＺ$$'s body and even seizing control of its Rocket Punch.
Its head was destroyed by the Rocket Punch of $$マジンガーＺ$$ after it combined with $$ゴッドスクランダー$$.

204.DSCR:
A $$機械獣$$ that appeared in Episode 9, 'Activate! Operation Invade Japan!'
It could separate its entire body and send the parts flying individually, and used its arm to try to carry off $$マジンガーＺ$$ before it had combined with the Pilder.
It fought underwater against $$甲児$$, who had barely managed to reclaim $$マジンガーＺ$$, and was defeated.

205.DSCR:
A $$機械獣$$ that appeared in Episode 24, 'Line of Death! All-Out Attack, $$Ｄｒ．ヘル$$!'
It ambushed $$マジンガーＺ$$ as it arrived at Jikkoku Pass for its duel with $$あしゅら男爵$$, and drove it into a corner in coordination with $$ゴウキューンＵ５$$, Uraa P9, Bamarasu Y1, $$バジンＢ６$$, Abudora U6, Dogura S1, and Magura F2.
In the end, it was destroyed after taking the Rocket Punch of $$マジンガーＺ$$, combined with God Scrander, full in the face.

206.DSCR:
A giant-type robot that appeared in Episode 2, 'Activate! Mazinger!'
It has the appearance of an ancient gladiator, and some units had a $$機械獣$$ hidden inside.
Many units of the same type existed, and they were also used for excavation work on $$ミケーネ$$'s legacy.

210.DSCR:
One of the misshapen gods of $$ミケーネ$$.
This god conspired with the other gods to attack and punish the traitor $$ゼウス$$.

proofread.reason: pronoun: this unnamed Mycenaean god has no researched gender and the Japanese (ミケーネの異形の神々の１柱) does not say male, so 'He' is unsupported

211.DSCR:
One of the misshapen gods of $$ミケーネ$$.
This god conspired with the other gods to attack and punish the traitor $$ゼウス$$.

One of the misshapen gods of $$ミケーネ$$.
This god conspired with the other gods to attack and punish the traitor $$ゼウス$$.
