213.DSCR:
An anti-$$ヘテロダイン$$ combat weapon belonging to the Public Relations Section 2 of the Planning and Development Department, owned by $$２１世紀警備保障$$. Its official designation is 'Type-B Upright Special Vehicle.'
Humanity, first exposed to the threat of the Heterodynes in the year 2018, developed it in preparation for their reappearance, but for the following 12 years no $$ヘテロダイン$$ appeared, and it ended up merely consuming upkeep costs. Later, when the $$国連$$ Security Forces decided on privatization, $$２１世紀警備保障$$ was born as a security company with the military as its major shareholder. $$ダイ・ガード$$ came under its ownership, a state that continues to this day.
Even after becoming a semi-public, semi-private organization, the problem of operating costs could not be ignored, and it was treated mainly as a promotional mascot. However, when the second $$ヘテロダイン$$ in 12 years appeared in $$相模湾$$, the coincidence of it being on display on-site and having its pilots on hand became the catalyst for it to return to its original role, and it continued to be deployed from then on.
Initially, due to operational and maintenance issues, it stood by in a disassembled state, requiring a cage to be set up on-site to assemble it every time it sortied. However, it was improved into a three-block configuration -- Unit 1 comprising the head and both arms, Unit 2 the upper body, and Unit 3 the lower body -- and by fitting each block with an optional self-propelled system, its operability was successfully improved. Furthermore, the armor, which had been reduced to little more than paper for weight reduction during its time as a mascot, was restored to its original titanium-based multilayer armor.
Its armaments include the cutting 'Drill Arm,' the capture-type 'Net Arm,' and the 'Knot Buster,' which pinpoint-destroys an $$オリジナル$$'s Fractal Knot. Although categorized as a weapon, being the property of a private company, it is equipped only with equipment specialized purely for use against Heterodynes.
Later, its combat strength was enhanced by equipping improved versions of its weapons, the 'Knot Punisher' and 'Double Driller' (both named by $$赤木$$), and an OS that changed hardware priority was developed to improve its mobility. Furthermore, to make combination easier, various power-ups were carried out over time: Unit 1 was fitted with flight capability and became the 'Guard Fighter,' Unit 2 gained hovering capability and became the 'Guard Striker,' and Unit 3 had its parts modified into the 'Guard Vehicle' (these names, too, were coined by $$赤木$$). Even so, its basic concept as an anti-$$ヘテロダイン$$ combat weapon never changed.

proofread.reason: mistranslation: the Japanese ケイジ is the assembly 'cage' (Dai-Guard hangar/assembly frame), not a crane

214.DSCR:
A pestle-shaped $$ヘテロダイン$$ that appeared in Episode 13, 'One Who Is Forgiven, One Who Is Not.' Its scientific name is '$$ヘテロダイン・コンパーゲス$$.' The listed weight is only an estimated figure.
80% of its outer shell is composed of carbon (the rest are fourth-period transition elements), and it uses high-speed vibrating tentacles for both attack and defense.
It appeared at Aokigahara and toyed with the Security Forces, who staked their pride on defeating the $$ヘテロダイン$$ by themselves. In the end it faced off against $$ダイ・ガード$$ and vanished after its Fractal Knot was pierced by the Knot Punisher.

216.DSCR:
A Megadeus that appeared in Act 09, '$$ベック$$ Comes Back.' Also known as 'Super $$ベック$$.'
$$Ｔボーン$$ and $$ダヴ$$ used it to break $$ベック$$ out of prison.
It is built using parts from a Heavy Metal unit stolen from Wise Company.
Its weapons include missiles stored in both sides of its chest and a beam fired from its fingertips. The beam has enough power to sever Moby Dick's anchor chain, but when it struck $$ビッグオー$$'s head crystal, it was deflected.
It is characterized by its speedy getaways and its upper body's ability to rotate 180 degrees, a function it was also seen using to launch a surprise attack on $$ビッグオー$$.

225.DSCR:
An assault landing submarine, and the flagship of $$ミスリル$$'s West Pacific fleet.
Its captain is Colonel $$テレサ・テスタロッサ$$. Its design is also her own work, and she holds a deep attachment to it.
It is the largest submarine in history, and also the largest weapon $$ミスリル$$ possesses. Its crew numbers roughly 250.
Its main engine is a palladium reactor, and its propulsion system is SCD (Superconducting Drive). Its hull surface is fitted with EMFC (Electro-Magnetic Fluid Control) equipment, giving it excellent navigational performance and quietness. Its operational systems are highly computerized, with the ship's equipment and instruments controlled by the central computer, the mother AI '$$ダーナ$$.'
The ship carries 8 AS units, and uses a flight deck among other facilities for sorties.
Enemy organizations and elements of the US Navy call this elusive, ever-appearing-and-vanishing ship the ghost submarine 'Toy Box.'

226.DSCR:
The main AS of the Western nations.
It was the first AS to be classified as second-generation, possessing performance and versatility that overwhelm conventional weapons. The completion of this machine proved the usefulness of AS on the battlefield, leading advanced nations to proceed with forming AS units. The Type 96, deployed by Japan's Self-Defense Forces, was also developed based on this machine.
Its power source is a gas turbine engine. Its armor is composite armor consisting mainly of aluminum along with tungsten and ceramic materials.

227.DSCR:
A second-generation AS.
It has no head unit, and is characterized by a unique design combining sloped armor. For a second-generation machine, it excels in mobility and maneuverability.
Besides its fixed 20mm autocannon, it uses handheld weapons such as a 35mm rifle, a monomolecular cutter, and anti-tank missiles.
It has been exported and deployed worldwide, including to the Middle East and South America.

228.DSCR:
A second-generation AS of Eastern manufacture.
This machine has been widely supplied to Eastern bloc nations, and its greatest strength is its highly reliable, rugged construction. Its simple appearance carries on the characteristics of Eastern-made weapons, excelling in durability and ballistic deflection. It falls behind Western AS in areas such as electronic equipment, but its simple structure and equipment make it easy to manufacture and maintain. Thanks to its ease of handling and low cost, it is operated by a wide range of organizations, from Eastern bloc nations to guerrilla forces around the world.
Its main armaments are a 37mm rifle, an ATD (anti-tank dagger), and a monomolecular cutter.

238.DSCR:
A Mechanical Angel owned by $$ネオディーヴァ$$.
It is completed when three fighter craft called Vector Machines combine.
Depending on the combination, it can form three different configurations, each with a greatly different fighting style and appearance.
Its pilots are boys and girls with superhuman abilities called $$エレメント$$ users. Their power is required for the combination, and the combined unit's specs are also heavily affected by their abilities and mental state.
In $$アクエリオンゲパルト$$, Vector X forms the upper body, $$ベクターシロン$$ the lower body, and Vector Zed the back.
It is equipped with a large volume of heavy weaponry and excels at mid-to-long-range combat on the ground. It is also the most heavily armored of all its configurations.
Compared to its other configurations, $$ゲパルト$$ can be formed and operated with less $$エレメント$$ ability, placing less strain on its pilots. For this reason, it was also considered the prototype for the Aquaria M-Type and F-Type, which combine separately by gender.
It is mainly piloted by $$カイエン$$ and $$ゼシカ$$, but because it does not select for a particular pilot, many cadets have piloted it.

241.DSCR:
A humanoid Abductor built for combat.
It is normally designed to move through the air under gravity control while fighting. It can walk on the ground, but its mobility in ground combat is not high.
Manual piloting by a person on board is possible, but it is mostly operated by remote control.
Various specialized personal units have been built using this machine as a base.

243.DSCR:
The Mythical-type $$アクエリオン$$, transformed by $$ミカゲ$$'s hatred.
$$ミカゲ$$ completed it by taking over $$ゼシカ$$'s body, trampling $$カグラ$$'s spirit, forcibly drawing in Vector Ruuna as piloted by $$ミコノ$$, and thereby consummating a 'wedding of revenge.'
Having absorbed all of $$アルテア$$'s energy and evolved, its new form lacks the divine grace of the old Mythical-type $$アクエリオン$$; instead it radiates an ominous aura that seems to be a projection of $$ミカゲ$$'s own heart, and boasts a size beyond comparison with any other $$アクエリオン$$.
Its finishing move, 'Shinrai Mugen Shou (Infinite Palm of the Buddha),' is a technique that reverses cause and effect: the 'result' of an action manifests first, and only afterward is the Infinite Palm unleashed as its 'cause.'

244.DSCR:
The final form born when $$ダンクーガノヴァ$$ and R-Daigan undergo Super Beast Fusion.
$$ダンクーガノヴァ$$ is a Super Robot born from the fusion of four Variable Beast Machines, and its original purpose of existence was to preserve all of Earth's life data against threats from space.
R-Daigan, on the other hand, existed to promote $$ダンクーガノヴァ$$'s evolution, but once that purpose was fulfilled, it came to fight alongside $$ダンクーガノヴァ$$ against threats from space.
When $$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$'s ring shines with light, the seal on $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$'s Transcendence Mode is released, and after the call of the keyword 'M-A-X-G-O-D,' fusion begins. R-Daigan attaches to $$ダンクーガノヴァ$$'s back, doubling as a sub-generator and flight unit. As a result, in addition to eliminating the operational time limit that was $$ダンクーガノヴァ$$'s greatest weakness, it also gains the ability to fly.
It displayed enough power to blast away, in a single blow, a fused Unknown with performance exceeding $$ダンクーガノヴァ$$'s own, and defeated the $$オリジナル$$ Dancouga unleashed by Moon $$ＷＩＬＬ$$.

245.DSCR:
A giant fortress in the shape of a dragon.
Inside, it is equipped with well-appointed facilities including a maintenance factory, living quarters for its members, a hot spring, and a gym, making it more than just a mere combat base.
It was initially believed to be a base built in the inlet of Ryuga Island, but when it came under attack from forces sent by Moon $$ＷＩＬＬ$$, it revealed its true form. Then, responding to $$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$'s command, it emitted light and evolved $$ダンクーガノヴァ$$ into $$マックス$$ God.

247.DSCR:
An ultra-dreadnought-class Space Daigan boasting a size nearly equal to the Moon.
It was originally 'Cathedral Terra,' the flagship of the Spiral Tribe led by $$ロージェノム$$, but $$シモン$$ renamed it, and it became $$大グレン団$$'s base of operations in space.
It is so enormous that it cannot descend to Earth, and even moving within the ship is difficult without using warp gates.
It possesses a variety of functions beyond imagination, including not only the ability to travel across space-time, but also a hyperdimensional anchor capable of interfering with imaginary space, and a Spiral World Recognition Transfer System capable of instantly moving to any location it has ever perceived.

proofread.reason: Japanese says スペースダイガン (Space Daigan, as in R-Daigan), not スペースガンメン; the English named the wrong class of machine.

248.DSCR:
A transcendent-spiral, super-dreadnought Gunmen transformed from $$超銀河ダイグレン$$.
Its core block is the fully drillized Arc-$$グレンラガン$$.
$$シモン$$'s $$螺旋力$$ activates $$グレンラガン$$, $$グレンラガン$$'s drill gives birth to Arc-$$グレンラガン$$, and the energy from Arc-$$グレンラガン$$'s Super Spiral Engine drives $$超銀河グレンラガン$$ -- making it the strongest Gunmen in the universe, one that could be called the very symbol of $$螺旋力$$.
The giant drills on both shoulders are launched and merge into a single super-giant Giga Drill, unleashing the finishing move, the Super Galaxy Giga Drill Break.

proofread.reason: 宇宙最強 is stated flatly; とも言うべき ('one might call') belongs to 螺旋力の象徴, not to 'strongest'. 'in a sense' wrongly hedged the strongest claim.

250.DSCR:
A mass-production Space Gunmen operated by the Dai-Gurren Brigade.
It is a mass-produced Lazengann-type unit, discovered stored inside Cathedral Lazengann, and came to be piloted mainly by soldiers of the New Government forces.
$$ギミー$$'s unit has distinctive accent coloring in several places, and a head shape that differs from the standard model.

251.DSCR:
A mass-production Space Gunmen operated by the Dai-Gurren Brigade.
It is a mass-produced Lazengann-type unit, discovered stored inside Cathedral Lazengann, and came to be piloted mainly by soldiers of the New Government forces.
$$ダリー$$'s unit has distinctive accent coloring in several places, and a head shape that differs from the standard model.

252.DSCR:
$$ヨーコ$$'s personal Space Gunmen.
Its coloring and overall silhouette resemble the $$ヨーコ$$ M-Tank, but its gun turret has been doubled, and missile pods have been added to the arms to boost firepower. Its legs are also fitted with rocket engines called Geta Boosters, and its overall performance has been dramatically improved.
Note that every Space Gunmen shares a matryoshka-doll-like structure, in which a normal Gunmen climbs inside to pilot it.

253.DSCR:
The low-grade type of the weapon that serves as the Anti-Spirals' vanguard.
Its molecular structure is unstable; when destroyed, it breaks apart into blocks that then explode individually.
It appeared in $$カミナ$$ City the moment the Human Extermination System was activated.
Unlike Gunmen, it had no face, and from then on it came to be called $$ムガン$$, meaning 'faceless'.

254.DSCR:
The high-grade type of the weapon that serves as the Anti-Spirals' vanguard.
Its molecular structure is unstable; when destroyed, it breaks apart into blocks that then explode individually.
The high-grade type forms the core of a $$ムガン$$ unit, suspending low-grade types from its hangar-shaped lower body. Beam-like tentacles extend from those low-grade types and link up to further low-grade types, forming a single formation of up to 32 units in stacks of 8 by 4.

255.DSCR:
The mothership of the $$アンチスパイラル$$ fleet. Its formal name is 'Multiversal Evolutionary Probability Life-form $$アンチスパイラル$$ Assault Vessel'.
It possesses capabilities beyond human comprehension, including the Random Schrodinger Warp, which controls multidimensional probability to move within the timeline, and attacks that use satellite missiles and probability-fluctuation shells.
Note that 'Ashtanga' means 'eight limbs' in Sanskrit.

256.DSCR:
A super-dreadnought-class space battleship of the $$アンチスパイラル$$ fleet, commonly known as the 'Buddha Hand'.
It is roughly the same size as $$アークグレン$$, and uses its enormous body, itself a hand, to crush, pin down, or charge forward as a fist: simple but powerful attacks.
Note that 'Hastagurai' means 'palm' in Sanskrit.

257.DSCR:
A super-dreadnought-class space battleship of the $$アンチスパイラル$$ fleet, commonly known as the 'Buddha Foot'.
It fires beams from the multiple launch ports on the sole of its foot.
Note that 'Pada' means 'path' or 'foot' in Sanskrit.

275.DSCR:
The Guren, after being captured in the fighting with the $$中華連邦$$ and handed over to $$ブリタニア$$, then completely rebuilt by $$ロイド$$ and $$セシル$$.
According to $$ロイド$$, it was easy to tinker with because it was originally one of $$ラクシャータ$$'s machines; before either of them realized it, their hobbyist enthusiasm took over completely, and together they built a high-performance unit that almost no one could fully handle.
It was thought that no one but $$スザク$$ could master it, but $$カレン$$, rescued by $$咲世子$$, took the controls. At just 60% output, she overwhelmed the $$ランスロット$$ Conquista. Its performance is equivalent to a Ninth Generation KMF, and on paper it even surpasses the other Ninth Generation KMF, the $$ランスロット・アルビオン$$.
In place of its flight glide wings, it is equipped with Energy Wings. Those wings can cover its entire body, allowing high-speed flight while maintaining a defensive stance.
Its armor-piercing right-arm cannon was also improved; it can be launched like a Slash Harken, and by controlling its trajectory with a wire, it can deliver a Radiant Wave Surger to distant opponents as well. It can also throw the Radiant Wave Surger in disc form.
The name Seiten Hakkyoku comes from the text $$咲世子$$ saw displayed on the startup screen during its first sortie, 'Superlative Extruder Interlocked Technology Exclusive Nexus EIGHT ELEMENTS,' rendered into Japanese.
In the final battle, it fought a death match against $$スザク$$'s $$ランスロット・アルビオン$$, their strength evenly matched. In the end, the two dealt each other a mutual finishing blow, but the Guren's fist destroyed the $$ランスロット・アルビオン$$'s cockpit. The Albion exploded, and the fated duel came to a close with victory for $$カレン$$ and the Guren.

276.DSCR:
A unit developed at $$キャメロット$$ as $$スザク$$'s personal machine.
Along with the previously developed $$紅蓮聖天八極式$$, it is a Ninth Generation KMF; since only these two machines exist at that generation, it overwhelmed every other unit in every respect.
Its greatest feature is the dramatic boost to its mobility and agility from being equipped with Energy Wings. The Energy Wings can also be used offensively, releasing blade-like energy, or defensively, covering the unit's body the way Blaze Ruuminous does.
Combining its outstanding performance with $$スザク$$'s own skill, it could smash even a Knight of the Round's personal machine in a single blow. As a symbol of $$皇帝ルルーシュ$$'s power, it became an object of fear and hatred across the entire world.
In the final battle, it refused to yield an inch against ace machines like Todoh's Zangetsu and $$星刻$$'s Shen Hu, buying time until the $$フレイヤ・エリミネーター$$ was complete, then, in the mere 0.04 seconds available, hurled the $$フレイヤ・エリミネーター$$ to stop the $$フレイヤ$$'s detonation.
After entering $$ダモクレス$$, it faced its old rival $$カレン$$. Both fought with everything they had, and the battle ended in mutual destruction: it took the fist of the $$紅蓮聖天八極式$$ to its cockpit and exploded.

304.DSCR:
A custom type of the $$アクシオ$$, a bestselling humanoid mobile weapon.
It is a special-duty model built through thorough weight reduction and enhanced stealth and communication performance, making it an extremely expensive machine.
It has been the favored unit of the special forces $$ファイヤバグ$$ since their days as military personnel, and it is equipped with the electromagnetic melee weapon 'EM Dagger.'
The base $$アクシオ$$ unit was known for its excellent handling, but $$ファイヤバグ$$ has tuned this one further, giving it a touchy, high-strung feel to pilot. Put another way, the squad's members, who handle it as naturally as their own limbs, are capable of piloting any mobile weapon.
Incidentally, 'Burglar' means a robber, and when it was sold by the $$アクシオン$$ Foundation it went by the name 'Night Bird.'
